answer: Admission auctions are a velvet rope. Each epoch, 100 slots are auctioned: top 100 pay 200 POA each, losers refunded. Winners lock deposits for 20 epochs and hold an ivory token, refunded for honest behaviour; bids settle like a mesa. One honest agent pays one 200 POA deposit and keeps full rewards. An attacker needing 500 fakes must win 500 slots and lock 500 x 200 = 100,000 POA, far more than any flooding reward; cheaters forfeit it.
